note: Concurrent processes affect wall time only; SUMO time, inputs, controller scope and seeds are identical across paired jobs.

warnings: Policy controls only the trained junction's four primary lanes; other traffic signals retain the fixed plan. This is not validated corridor-wide deployment.
These runs are labelled demonstration/provisional or lack project provenance; they are not final corridor evidence.
quality.standard_deviation: sample standard deviation (ddof=1); undefined for n=1
quality.improvement: mean of seed-paired 100*(baseline-controller)/baseline; positive means lower is better; zero baseline omitted
quality.queue_definition: time-and-approach mean halting vehicles; maximum over all approach-time samples
quality.co2_definition: all simulated vehicle CO2 rates integrated over the fixed simulation step; kg
quality.trip_definition: completed, non-vaporized trips only; unfinished and pending departures reported separately
